lines.text: The Reubenites and Gadites, with large herds, ask Moses for the land of Jazer and Gilead instead of crossing the Jordan.
Moses says their fathers saw the land from the Valley of Eshcol, and the LORD made Israel wander forty years.
The LORD swore that of the men twenty or older, only Caleb son of Jephunneh and Aaron son of Nun would see the land.
Moses says if every armed man crosses until the land is subdued, they may return; otherwise their sin will find them out.
Moses gave Gad, Reuben and half of Manasseh the kingdoms of Sihon king of the Amorites and Og king of Moab.
